لث: لَثَّ 1 , [aor. ﹻ,] inf. n. لَثٌّ; (K;) and 🡻الثّ (in the T أَلْثَثَ,) inf. n. إِلْثَاثٌ; and 🡻لَثْلَثَ, inf. n. لَثْلَثَةٌ; (As, S, K;) He remained, stayed, abode, or dwelt; (As, S, K;) بِمَكَانٍ in a place; (As, S;) and quitted it not. (TA.) So in the words of a trad., لَا تُلِثُّوا بِدَارِ مَعْجَزَةٍ, and مَعْجِزَةٍ, (S,) [Remain ye not in a dwelling of impotence]: i. e., remain not in a dwelling where ye cannot obtain sustenance: or remain not on the frontiers, having your households with you. (TA.) === لَثَّ, [aor. ﹻ,] inf. n. لَثٌّ; (K;) and 🡻الثّ, inf. n. إِلْثَاثٌ; (S, K;) and 🡻لَثْلَثَ, inf. n. لَثْلَثَةٌ; (K;) It (rain) continued (S, K) for days, incessantly: (S:) and in like manner a cloud. (TA.) === لَثَّ الشَّجَرَ, [aor. ﹹ,] It (dew, or day-dew, لَثٌّ,) fell upon the trees. (K.) The noun is in the acc. case. (TA.) === لَثَّ عَلَيْهِ, [aor. ﹻ,] inf. n. لَثٌّ; (K;) and 🡻الثّعليه, inf. n. إِلْثَاثٌ; (AA, S, K;) and 🡻لَثْلَثَ, inf. n. لَثْلَثَةٌ; (K;) He importuned him; was urgent with him. (AA, S, K.)
لَثٌّ Dew; or day-dew; syn. نَدًى. (K.)
لثلاث: لَثْلَاثٌ (so in the K, but in the L and other lexicons لَثْلَثٌ, TA,) and 🡻لَثْلَاثَةٌ One who is slow, or tardy, (in every affair, TA,) drawing back whenever thou thinkest that he hath consented to do what thou wantest. (K.)
لثا: لَثَأَ 1 , aor. ﹷ, He (a dog) put his muzzle into a vessel &c., and lapped. (K.) Omitted by J because held by him incorrect. (TA.)
لثة: لِثَةٌ The gum, accord. to some, belongs to this art., because the flesh of the gums is bound (لِيثَ) round the roots of the teeth. (TA.)
لِثَةٌ The gum. See art. لوث.
لثفة: لُثْفَةٌ The changing, in pronunciation, س into ث, or ر into غ or ل, (S, K, Msb,) and the like: (Msb:) or, one letter into another. (Az, in Msb, K.) Also, A word mispronounced; as when a word is said to be لُغَةٌ أَوْ لُثْفَةٌ a dialectal variant or a word mispronounced.
لثام: لِثَامٌ A kind of muffler for the mouth. (K.)
